rationale: The tape shows a complete gap-and-fade: price opened ~7.5% above prior close, was distributed all session, has fully filled the gap, and is now pinned 0.14% above the low of day and ~$7 below session VWAP on 2.5x relative volume. Chasing short here means entering at the extreme of a $16 range with the tape coiled in a 50-cent consolidation (break direction unknowable), while going long means fading a full-day downtrend with no reversal signal—each rally attempt in the last 25 minutes was absorbed below 150.85. With only 10 minutes to close, neither a breakdown continuation nor an exhaustion bounce has time or room to clear costs by a favorable ratio, so the mechanical edge in both directions is too thin to justify entry.
